overall_reason: The page says it has no design system and uses near-browser defaults (system-ui, #222 text, #ccc table borders, link blue), which give a very small set of values reused throughout, with one near-duplicate grey.

score.reason: T-VALUE-INVENTORY passes (5 text colours, 6 sizes, square corners for 463 elements) and T-DRIFT-PAIRS finds one surface pair (TOK-010); the neutral fills and button paddings are browser defaults rather than the page's own choices.

findings.where: table header cells against filter and action buttons; 1440 (tiles/1440-00.png)
findings.evidence: values.1440.colour_fill.near_duplicates pairs #f3f3f3 (11) and #f0f0f0 (7), 0.009 OKLab apart: the table header fill and the default button fill. spacing pairs 7 and 8px and 19 and 20px, and button padding renders 6.5 and 9.5px.
findings.before: Two near-equal greys for neutral fills; fractional default button padding
findings.after: One neutral fill for headers and buttons; button padding on the page's 8px rhythm
findings.why: Two greys for one neutral job is drift, even on a deliberately plain page.

strengths: A very small value set reused everywhere: system-ui, 16px body, 8px rhythm, #ccc rules.
